01a0b5ad-0558-7902-8b1e-1802ba80bc01.instruction: Ask for a unique ID, then call send_message once with unique_id and a short confirmation message. Do not ask for or pass account, phone, customer name, city, campaign, segment, or locale. Wait for the actual result, then read the message id, recipient phone, and context snapshot from the returned result.
